items.title: Microsoft holds Windows and Surface news event in San Francisco covering on-device AI and agent sandboxing
items.summary_en: Per Microsoft's newsroom page, the event covered hybrid intelligence on PCs, a sandboxing layer for AI agents, and a new Surface Laptop Ultra. The page also references a model named MAI-Code-1.1-Flash. Nadella and NVIDIA's Jensen Huang appear in the event imagery.

items.title: Copilot on Windows to get 'Hybrid Intelligence' using local models and, with permission, PC context
items.summary_en: A Microsoft Source newsroom item reportedly dated October 8 says Copilot on Windows will use local models alongside cloud ones. With user permission, it can draw on context from the PC.

items.title: Usage-based billing default for new Microsoft 365 Copilot Business CSP licenses moved to December 1, 2026
items.summary_en: Partner Center announcements say usage-based billing will be on by default for new Microsoft 365 Copilot Business licenses bought through CSP, starting December 1, 2026 (previously November 2). The default spending limit is 4,000 Copilot Credits per user per month, adjustable by admins.
items.notes: Not fetched; search snippet. Date is the page's month, not a confirmed day (likely outside window). Commercial item, low research relevance.

items.title: Copilot in SharePoint reported generally available from September 30; new features listed
items.summary_en: A Microsoft Tech Community post says Copilot in SharePoint began rolling out as generally available on September 30. New features include PDF page-level editing, version restore through chat, and email sending.
items.notes: Not fetched; snippet only. Date approximate; GA date (Sept 30) is just outside the window.
